CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_rooms (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,approved_idea_id VARCHAR(64),approved_idea_version INTEGER,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX room_owner (owner_id,updated_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_room_members (room_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,joined_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(room_id,user_id),INDEX room_member_user (user_id,room_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_room_invites (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,room_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,revoked_at VARCHAR(40),accepted_by VARCHAR(64),created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX room_invite_room (room_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_room_ideas (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,room_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX room_idea_room (room_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_room_votes (room_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,idea_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(idea_id,user_id),INDEX room_votes_room (room_id,idea_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS design_room_messages (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,room_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX room_messages_room (room_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
